Frequently asked questions\r\n\r\nWhy wa:
Frequently asked questions

Why was my action refused?
The server decides movement, combat and inventory results. Read its feedback and try a reachable target or a different item.

Where are my settings saved?
Settings are local to this computer. Help / settings transfer lets you export them, import a saved file, restore a backup or restore defaults. A replacement saves the previous settings first.

How do I change shortcuts?
Open Controls, select an action and enter a new key combination. Conflicting bindings must be resolved before saving.

Why is a feature unavailable?
Some panels require support from the current server session. Settings cannot enable an unavailable server feature.

How do I recover from a connection loss?
Return to sign-in and retry. Do not assume an item transfer or logout completed until the server confirms it.

Help and support\r\n\r\nBug report: Ctrl:
Help and support

Bug report: Ctrl+Shift+F12 opens categories for map, typo, client behavior and other issues. Include reproduction steps and review the exact report. Build details are optional.
Violation: Ctrl+Alt+R opens player reports. Select name, statement or bot; choose the operator's reason code and quote evidence. An optional translation is marked unverified. Review before sending.
Crash report: after a crash, the next launch offers a preview and asks before saving a local report. No automatic upload occurs.
Connection problems: use Retry sign-in to start a fresh attempt. For installation problems, use the launcher installation check and follow the repair instructions.
About and optional survey are available in the sign-in window.

Player Guide

Movement: use arrow keys or left-click a reachable map tile.
Interaction: right-click a creature or object to inspect its available actions.
Inventory: select an item before using, moving or equipping it. The server confirms changes.
Combat: select a target and check your fight and chase settings. Stop attacking before approaching other players.
Tutorial overlay: Ctrl+Alt+Shift+N toggles contextual hints, target markers and the mouse trail.
Notices: Ctrl+Shift+N reopens this guide and the latest tutorial/server-save messages.
Leaving: use the logout action and wait for server confirmation; a refusal leaves the session active.

Recommendations\r\n\r\nBefore exploring::
Recommendations

Before exploring: check equipment, carrying capacity and healing supplies.
Before a hunt: choose a suitable target, check your route back and keep reserve supplies.
During a hunt: monitor health, mana and conditions; stop and recover before continuing if resources are low.
Before server-save: read the latest announcement in Notices and find a safe place to log out.
After connection loss: return to sign-in and complete sign-in in your browser again.
If something looks wrong: record reproduction steps and review a bug report before sending it.
